title: Torah and Space Technology
summary_researcher: Published letter to Prof. Zeev Greene. The page states that it follows a recent conversation and discusses possible Jewish educational influence in relation to NASA and contemporary space technology.
response_propositions: Jewish education and observance should be extended to Jews of every age, including adults who are still young in Jewish knowledge and experience.
Contemporary science and space exploration may be used educationally by identifying connections to Torah and mitzvot that can encourage practical observance.
proposition_source_locator: Authorized Chabad.org letter body, paragraphs beginning 'I mention NASA...' and 'Consequently, since you have the special merit...'
